verdict.rationale: Azure is a broad cloud platform that includes AI features such as Azure Copilot, so it could plausibly consume external MCP servers and the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents Azure acting as an MCP client or letting users register MCP servers for it to call. The official Microsoft MCP server (azure-probe-4) is the server role, a separate story, and does not count here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
